appDescription.message: Free and open-source workspaces for your tabs. Unlimited spaces, resources, notes, tasks and tab suspension.

cmdMoveTab.message: Save or move the current tab to a workspace

menuSuspendOthers.message: Suspend other tabs in this window

confirmDeleteWorkspace.message: Delete "$p1$"? Its saved tabs, resources, notes and tasks will be lost.

unsavedWindowLong.message: This window isn't a workspace yet. Save it to keep its tabs, or open one of your workspaces.

noSavedTabs.message: No saved tabs. Opening this workspace starts with a new tab.

openModeCurrent.message: Open in the current window (swap tabs)

openModeNewWindow.message: Always open in a new window

openModeHint.message: Windows with unsaved tabs are never replaced: the workspace opens in a new window instead.

lazyLoadDesc.message: Only the active tab loads when you open a workspace. The rest load when you click them.

suspensionDesc.message: Suspended tabs stay in the tab strip but free their memory until you click them.

toolbarButtonDesc.message: You can always use the other one from the menu or a shortcut.

exportDesc.message: Download all workspaces, resources, notes and settings as a JSON file.

confirmReplaceImport.message: Replace ALL your current workspaces with the file contents?

aboutLine.message: Free and open source, forever. MIT license.

welcomeSubtitle.message: Organize your tabs into workspaces. Unlimited, free and open source. No account, no tracking, everything stays in your browser.

welcomeStep1Title.message: Save a window as a workspace

welcomeStep1Text.message: Each workspace is a set of tabs. Switching swaps the tabs of your window, and everything is saved automatically.

welcomeStep2Text.message: Open the quick switcher, type to search across workspaces, tabs and resources, press Enter. Alt+T moves the current tab.

welcomeStep3Text.message: Save important links in sections, write notes and keep a to-do list for every workspace. Alt+S opens the side panel.

welcomeStep4Text.message: Restored tabs load on demand and inactive tabs can be suspended automatically. Configure it in Settings.

welcomeFootnote.message: Tip: pin the extension to the toolbar so the switcher is one click away.

imageFailed.message: Couldn't read that image. Try a PNG, ICO, SVG, JPG or WebP file under 5 MB.

uploadImageHint.message: PNG, ICO, SVG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB

noOpenTabs.message: No tabs besides the pinned ones.

homeTabSetting.message: Extension icon in the tab strip

homeTabDesc.message: Keeps a small pinned tab with the Open Workspaces icon at the left of every window. Click it to see and switch workspaces.

keepPinnedSetting.message: Pinned tabs stay in every workspace

keepPinnedDesc.message: Tabs you pin in the browser (like Gmail or YouTube) stay open when you switch workspaces instead of being saved into one.

pinAskDesc.message: The tab moves to the left of the tab strip and stays open when you switch workspaces.

pinSuggestionsDesc.message: When you open Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp, Slack, Teams, Discord, Spotify and similar sites in a tab that is not pinned, asks once per browser session whether to keep them pinned in every workspace.

keepAliveOn.message: Keeps running when you switch workspaces

keepAliveDone.message: This tab keeps running when you switch workspaces

menuKeepAlive.message: Keep this tab running when switching workspaces

homeOnSwitchSetting.message: Show this page after switching workspaces

homeOnSwitchDesc.message: After a switch the window stays on the Open Workspaces tab, showing the workspace you opened, instead of jumping to its last used tab. That tab still loads in the background, ready to click.

warmSetting.message: Keep the tabs of a workspace you leave open

warmDesc.message: They wait, still loaded, in a collapsed group at the end of the window. Come back in time and they return as they were, without reloading. Each tab closes after this long unused; one playing sound waits for it to stop.
